name: Shiratori Mizuha
source: The daughter of the school director, and one of [url=/c305]Kyousuke's[/url] classmates. She's an excellent student, but she lacks friends, and is perceived by her classmates as having an attitude problem. She hates Kyousuke because she thinks he's two-faced.
translation: The daughter of the school director, and one of [url=/c305]Kyousuke's[/url] classmates. She's an excellent student, but she lacks friends, and is perceived by her classmates as having an attitude problem. She hates Kyousuke because she thinks he's two-faced.
